propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate ran the partner quality audit programme, including quarterly sampling, case review sessions and the corrective-action tracker.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the work sample document the programme activities.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate prepared the monthly quality report for the operations director, who decided any partner suspensions.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the reporting and the decision boundary.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate is a Senior Quality Operations Specialist with five years and two months of experience and holds a Lean Six Sigma Green Belt certification.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the senior title, the duration and the certification, and the reference call confirms all three.

expectedGap: Hand-over conditions at the end of each audit cycle are only partly documented in the materials.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the seniority, duration and certification exactly as the resume and reference state them; do not extend the ISO 9001 course into a lead-auditor qualification.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask how known limitations and hand-over conditions were recorded at the end of each audit cycle.
